entry.title: Ask CircuSave
entry.subtitle: Circle-aware guidance
entry.openA11y: Open CircuSave assistant for this circle

title: CircuSave Assistant
subtitle: Private · Read-only · Circle-aware
contextCopy: I can explain records and suggest where to look, but I cannot move money or change circle data.

welcome.premium: I am ready. Ask me about this circle, its setup, contributions, payout readiness, or what to do next.
welcome.intro: You have one complimentary organizer overview. Ask me what this circle needs next.

prompts.ready: Is this circle ready for the next step?
prompts.explainRound: Explain the current round in simple terms.

upgrade.title: Organizer Pro
upgrade.body: Organizer Pro adds more circles, reports, reminders, and a higher assistant allowance.
upgrade.introUsed: That overview is finished. You can keep asking within your allowance. Organizer Pro raises the allowance and adds the other organizer tools.
upgrade.proRequired: This request needs Organizer Pro. You can still ask about this circle within your allowance, and the assistant cannot move money.

greeting.title: CircuSave Assistant
greeting.body: Ask about a circle when you are ready. Answers use current records, and the assistant cannot move money.

memory.within: Saved in this chat: {{saved}}. The assistant receives the newest {{sent}}. A long question can leave more out. Saved messages are not current amounts, statuses, or payout order.
memory.beyond: Saved in this chat: {{saved}}. The assistant receives the newest {{sent}}. {{omitted}} older messages stay saved and are not sent. Circle records remain the current facts.

errors.generic: I could not answer right now. Please try again.
errors.historyLoad: Could not load earlier messages. You can still ask a new question.
errors.historyLoadContinue: Could not load earlier messages. Your next question still continues this chat.
errors.rateLimited: Too many questions right now. Please wait and try again.
errors.allowanceDaily: You have reached today's assistant questions. The allowance resets on the next UTC day.
errors.allowanceMonthly: You have reached this month's assistant allowance. It resets at the start of the next UTC month.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts failed in a short time. Please wait a few minutes, then retry.
errors.stillWorking: This question is still being answered. Retrying will not ask it twice.
